name: shoplite
description: A small webshop: Vue frontend and TypeScript API

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
